title: A Gold-Standard Study of What Makes a Lightweight Game-Playing Agent Strong
abstract: arXiv:2607.06854v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents for imperfect-information card games are only as strong as the opponents they train against, and they are hard to grade, since they beat a random opponent over 99 percent of the time and only tie copies of themselves. So we build a strong, fixed, rule-based expert for Gin Rummy and use it only as a yardstick, never for training. It beats every agent we trained 70 to 99 percent of the time. Across more than a hundred runs, we isolate what makes a lightweight agent stronger. Trust region updates, a well-aimed reward, a curriculum of tougher opponents, warm starting, and keeping the best checkpoint all help, and stacking them lifts a self-play champion from about 30 to 36 percent against the expert. Several ideas did not pay off. translated_title: 什么使轻量级游戏智能体变强的黄金标准研究
translated_abstract: 不完美信息纸牌游戏的强化学习智能体的强度取决于其训练对手的强度，而且这类智能体很难评估，因为它们战胜随机对手的概率超过99%，而与自身副本对战时只能打成平局。因此，我们为金拉米牌游戏构建了一个强大的、固定的、基于规则的专家系统，仅将其用作衡量标尺，绝不用于训练。该专家以70%到99%的胜率击败了我们训练的所有智能体。在超过一百次实验运行中，我们分离出了使轻量级智能体更强的关键因素。信任域更新、精心设计的奖励、难度递增的课程式对手、热启动以及保留最佳检查点都有帮助，将这些方法叠加使用，可将自博弈冠军对抗专家的胜率从约30%提升至36%。然而，一些想法并未奏效：短期和长期奖励塑形、学习状态嵌入、模仿学习和DAgger算法，以及实时大语言模型对手，要么没有帮助，要么太慢，要么过于沉重。
tldr: 该研究为金拉米构建了一个固定的基于规则的专家智能体作为评估标尺，通过百余次实验发现信任域更新、精准奖励设计、课程式对手、热启动和保留最佳检查点可将轻量级强化学习智能体的胜率从约30%提升至36%，而奖励塑形、状态嵌入、模仿学习和大语言模型对手等方法则被证明无益。
en_tdlr: Using a fixed rule-based Gin Rummy expert as a benchmark, this study finds that trust region updates, well-aimed rewards, opponent curricula, warm starting, and best-checkpoint retention lift a lightweight RL agent's win rate from ~30% to 36%, while reward shaping, learned state embeddings, imitation learning, and live LLM opponents proved unhelpful.
